title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools for agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented background controls are supported, and it distinguishes those controls from the unconfirmed REST endpoint capability. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge Microsoft's inconsistent generic-tool count and cite the source supporting the discussion of REST write operations.

claims.quote: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.
